headline_item.title_zh: 美金融犯罪执法局披露系统遭入侵
headline_item.title_en: US financial crimes bureau discloses ‘cybersecurity incident’
headline_item.author: Lauren Feiner
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国财政部下属金融犯罪执法局（FinCEN）确认遭遇网络安全事件，导致部分系统被非法访问
headline_item.event_summary_en: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) of the U.S. Treasury has confirmed unauthorized access to a subset of its systems and initiated an investigation. FinCEN, responsible for anti-money laundering, has taken systems offline as a precaution while maintaining reporting channels via hotline.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国财政部金融犯罪执法局（FinCEN）在美国金融监管系统：遭遇非法访问导致部分系统停机
【起因与机理】网络安全漏洞导致敏感财务数据面临风险
【核心事实细节】FinCEN确认发生安全入侵事件，部分系统被迫下线。
【各方立场与态度】该机构掌握全球金融反洗钱关键敏感数据，安全后果仍在评估中。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) (U.S. financial regulatory system): Unauthorized access to internal systems
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] FinCEN confirms security breach, forcing partial system shutdown.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] The agency holds critical sensitive financial intelligence; security impact assessment is ongoing.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 作为全球金融反洗钱情报的核心节点，FinCEN的数据安全直接关联地缘政治博弈的资产追踪能力。此次入侵事件不仅考验其内控合规架构，更暴露了关键行政金融基础设施在应对高强度定向攻击时的脆弱性。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: As a central hub for global AML intelligence, a breach at FinCEN threatens sensitive asset-tracking capabilities critical to geopolitical strategy. This incident exposes vulnerabilities in administrative financial infrastructure when facing high-intensity, targeted cyber intrusions.

headlines.title_zh: 日韩半导体板块随美股AI回调暴跌
headlines.title_en: SoftBank drops over 11% as Wall Street AI sell-off ripples across Asian tech names
headlines.author: Lee Ying Shan
headlines.event_summary_zh: 受美股AI贸易预期降温及市场波动影响，Advantest、Tokyo Electron等日韩芯片股集体大跌
headlines.event_summary_en: Asian semiconductor stocks faced a rout following skepticism over ROI on AI capital expenditures and volatility in U.S. markets. Major suppliers including Tokyo Electron, Advantest, Samsung Electronics, and SK Hynix saw significant share price declines as AI accelerator demand confidence wavered.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】东京电子、Advantest、三星电子、SK海力士在亚太科技金融市场：股价遭遇两位数跌幅
【起因与机理】AI基础设施资本支出回报预期产生分歧
【关键数据与实测】Advantest与Tokyo Electron跌幅均超10%。
【各方立场与态度】市场担忧AI投资循环性及资本支出溢价水平。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Tokyo Electron, Advantest, Samsung, SK Hynix (Asian tech/financial markets): Double-digit share price declines
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Skepticism over ROI for AI capital spending
[Key Metrics] Advantest and Tokyo Electron shares dropped over 10%.
[Key Position & Outlook] Concerns regarding AI investment cycles and capital expenditure premiums are driving the sell-off.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 半导体板块的估值回调本质上是市场在修正AI基础设施的高溢价，资本市场正从单纯的算力扩张逻辑转向对具体落地营收的严苛审视。短期供应链阵痛将加速行业内部竞争的分化，产能过剩的担忧将促使下游客户审慎评估扩产节奏。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The semiconductor valuation correction reflects a shift from speculative capacity expansion to rigorous scrutiny of actual AI revenue generation. This short-term volatility will catalyze industry differentiation and pressure clients to reassess aggressive expansion timelines amid oversupply risks.

headlines.title_zh: 犹他州撤销对预测市场Kalshi刑事起诉
headlines.title_en: Utah prosecutors drop criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders, one day after the company halted operations in the state (Marshall Cohen/CNN)
headlines.author: CNN
headlines.event_summary_zh: 在Kalshi主动退出该州运营后，犹他州检察官撤销了针对该平台及其创始人的刑事指控
headlines.event_summary_en: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown dropped criminal charges against prediction market Kalshi and its founders after the company ceased operations in the state. This move signals an ongoing struggle between state anti-gambling laws and federal financial market regulation, with civil litigation still pending.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】犹他州检察长Derek Brown、预测市场平台Kalshi在犹他州法律诉讼环境：撤销刑事指控，前提是Kalshi退出该州
【起因与机理】地方州层面反赌博立法与联邦监管权归属存分歧
【调查与监管诉求】犹他州检察长Derek Brown宣布撤销对预测市场平台Kalshi及其创始人Tarek Mansour和Luana Lopes Lara的刑事起诉，前提是该公司已主动停止在该州的运营。
【各方立场与态度】通过刑事起诉迫使平台下架是州政府针对新兴金融衍生品的一种防卫性行政博弈，预计此类诉讼将持续推动预测市场在合规架构上被迫向“金融交易所”属性靠拢，以规避地方刑责。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Utah AG Derek Brown, Prediction market Kalshi (Utah legal jurisdiction): Charges dropped conditional on market exit
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Jurisdictional conflict between state anti-gambling laws and federal regulation
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Utah Attorney General Derek Brown dropped criminal charges against prediction market Kalshi and its founders after the company ceased operations in the state.

[Industry Impact & Outlook] State-level criminal pressure acts as a defensive administrative barrier; expect prediction platforms to increasingly align with 'financial exchange' definitions to mitigate local criminal liability risks.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 预测市场的合规界定已成为联邦金融监管与州地方行政法的核心摩擦点。通过刑事起诉迫使平台下架是州政府针对新兴金融衍生品的一种防卫性行政博弈，预计此类诉讼将持续推动预测市场在合规架构上被迫向“金融交易所”属性靠拢，以规避地方刑责。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The regulatory classification of prediction markets has become a friction point between federal financial oversight and state authorities. State-level criminal pressure acts as a defensive administrative barrier; expect prediction platforms to increasingly align with 'financial exchange' definitions to mitigate local criminal liability risks.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus 背景：
“在过去 20 年的大部分时间里，我一直在尝试训练模型进行视频预测，但在前 15 年基本上失败了。直到我意识到必须放弃生成模型并使用联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA)”

“过去几年，JEPA 和世界模型开始发挥作用。主要应用是物理世界、机器人和工业过程控制。Meta 对这些东西不是特别感兴趣”

但我的项目始终得到扎克、博兹、施雷普和克里斯·考克斯的支持。

确实，作为首席人工智能科学家，我虽然是高级副总裁级别，但却是一名 IC。公司最好的工作！

我从未攻读过法学硕士，这也是事实。我非常支持 FAIR 的 LLM 项目（例如后来成为 Llama 的项目），并在说服 Mark 围绕 Llama 创建人工智能优先产品部门方面发挥了作用，并推动开源 Llama-2。但我从来没有参与过技术层面的工作。
celebrity.quote_en:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus Context:
"I've tried to train models to do video prediction for the better part of the last 20 years, and largely failing for the first 15. Until I realized you had to abandon generative models and use joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA)" 

"Things started to work in the last few years with JEPA and world models. The main applications are in the physical world, robotics, and industrial process control. Things that Meta is not particularly interested in" 

But my project always had the support of Zuck, Boz, Schrep, and Chris Cox. 

It's true that, as Chief AI Scientist, I was at senior VP level but was an IC. Best job in the company! 

Also true that I never worked on LLMs. I was very supportive of LLM projects at FAIR (e.g. the project that became Llama), and played a role on convincing Mark to create an AI-first product division around Llama, and pushed to open source Llama-2. But I was never involved at the technical level.
celebrity.thesis_zh: 深入探讨世界模型与自监督的关键演进，直指核心工程落地与技术范式转移。
celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in World Models & SSL, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.
celebrity.debate_zh: 全球极客社群就此展开全网大讨论与热烈思辨。
celebrity.debate_en: Global developer community actively debates the broader industry implications.
